name: plugin
description: The participant skills of the Antasphere Hackathon: /plugin:join (from zero to your team's app running), /plugin:check (the doctor, the clock), and the three decks, each from the organizer's Slideless template, hosted with a share link and registered on the platform: /plugin:demo (episodes of Playwright screenshots), /plugin:pitch (the stage) and /plugin:vote (the elevator pitch the other participants read).
